codeReview.summary: The dashboard redesign hits the main visual assertions, but it regresses preserved i18n/accessibility behavior and misses one explicit no-alert hero styling requirement, so it should not pass as-is.

issues.description: The hero introduces hardcoded user-facing strings instead of preserving i18n. `Today` (line 209), `alert/alerts` (line 241), `All clear` (line 271), and fallback `Attention needed` (line 291) bypass `t()`, so this redesign breaks localization on the dashboard's new hero path.

The redesign removes existing section-header accessibility roles. The new `Needs Attention`, `Quick Actions`, and `Recent Activity` header Text nodes at lines 579, 691, and 838 no longer include `accessibilityRole="header"`, even though the pre-redesign file exposed those headings to assistive tech. That violates the requirement to preserve accessibility props.

The no-alert greeting branch does not apply the requested Fraunces styling. The text style only sets size/weight/color/lineHeight and has no `fontFamily`, so the fallback hero does not fully match the wireframe specification.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `ui-worker` skill says workers must read both `wireframe-{name}.html` and `wireframe-{name}-dark.html`, but this dashboard feature uses `wireframe-D.html` and there is no matching `wireframe-D-dark.html`. The worker searched for a dark variant, got no matches, and proceeded anyway. The skill should document the fallback dark-reference rule for screens that only have a shared dark wireframe.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `ui-worker` SKILL.md Step 2 requires both light and dark screen-specific wireframes; the transcript skeleton for session `07bcb180-93da-4738-a13b-68808be27510` shows a `Glob` for `**/wireframe-D*dark*.html` returning `No matching files found`; the design directory contains `wireframe-D.html` but no `wireframe-D-dark.html`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature handoff recorded an invalid full commit hash, which breaks downstream reviewers that rely on `handoff.commitId` to fetch the diff.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `/Users/ashishhuddar/.factory/missions/d1167030-fd5b-475b-aa51-e8e2e34457cd/handoffs/2026-03-29T21-25-41-710Z__dashboard-redesign__07bcb180-93da-4738-a13b-68808be27510.json` stores `98fae7497fe8a7b1fd7f0a1f0e0d0f4a4de2a41d`, but `git show` on that hash fails with `fatal: bad object`; `git rev-parse 98fae74` resolves to the actual commit `98fae7435e6bc34568f5116fa346f18c22b91912`.

summary: Fail: the dashboard visuals are largely in place, but the feature regresses localization and heading accessibility, and the no-alert hero misses the requested Fraunces treatment.
